occurrences.pixelObservations: Location: lower-middle center, directly left of 2+ and above ESSENTIAL DATA. Outer shape: an unenclosed, approximately bilateral solid-white figure with a rounded head, narrow neck, broad shoulders, short side projections, a tapering torso, and two lower projections, seated in approximately three nested horizontal elliptical rings. Internal marks: the head is featureless; dark gaps separate the side projections from the central body and divide the lower pair; the rings have pale-cyan highlights, electric-blue rims, dark-blue interiors, and visible intervening gaps. Colors: white, pale cyan, electric blue, dark blue, and black.
